body:
Navigating the bustling corridor between East Delhi and Western Uttar Pradesh can feel like decoding a complex puzzle. Whether you are a daily office commuter, a student rushing to college, or a traveller catching an interstate train, understanding the transition between Delhi and Ghaziabad is crucial.

This comprehensive guide breaks down the complete Anand Vihar to Ghaziabad distance, maps out the absolute best Anand Vihar to Ghaziabad metro route options, explores the high-speed Namo Bharat RRTS transit system, and provides exact answers to your most pressing commute questions.

## **Anand Vihar to Ghaziabad Distance: Overview of the Journey**

Before diving into the route maps, let's look at the foundational numbers. The geographic **distance from** [**Ghaziabad** ](https://metroguideindia.com/namo-bharat/stations/ghaziabad.html)**to** [**Anand Vihar** ](https://metroguideindia.com/namo-bharat/stations/anand-vihar.html)varies depending on your specific destination in Ghaziabad (such as Kaushambi, Vaishali, Sahibabad, Mohan Nagar, or the old city centre) and your chosen mode of transportation.

- **By Road (On-Wheel Distance):** The road distance from Anand Vihar ISBT/Terminal to central Ghaziabad is approximately **13 km to 16.4 km**, depending on the exact route taken via the Madan Mohan Malviya Marg or Link Road.
- **By High-Speed Rail (Namo Bharat RRTS track):** The direct track distance between Anand Vihar RRTS station and Ghaziabad RRTS station is exactly **10.7 km**.


- **By Delhi Metro Network:** The distance ranges between **3 km and 12 km** depending on whether your stop is just across the border (like Vaishali) or further inside the city (like Shaheed Sthal).

For a quick conversion guide for local travel queries:

**Anand Vihar se Ghaziabad kitna kilometre hai?**

_Anand Vihar se Ghaziabad ki sadak ki duri lagbhag **14-16 km** hai, jabki naye Namo Bharat Rapid Rail se yeh duri keval **10.7 km** hai. Agar aap Vaishali Metro ja rahe hain, toh yeh keval **3 km** ki duri par hai._

## **The Ultimate Anand Vihar to Ghaziabad Metro Route Options**

There is no single "correct" way to complete the journey from the **Anand Vihar Metro Station to Ghaziabad Metro Station**. Instead, the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) offers two distinct paths into different sectors of Ghaziabad.

### **Option 1: The Blue Line Extension (Direct to Vaishali)**

If your destination is near Kaushambi, Vaishali, or parts of Indirapuram, the Blue Line is your fastest traditional metro route.

- **Boarding Station:** Anand Vihar ISBT (Platform 1)


- **Line:** Blue Line (Branch Line towards Vaishali)


- **Intermediate Stations:** [Kaushambi](https://metroguideindia.com/delhi-metro/stations/kaushambi.html)


- **Terminal Station:** Vaishali (Ghaziabad)


- **Travel Time:** \~6 to 8 minutes
- **Fare:** ₹10 to ₹20

### **Option 2: The Red Line Route (To Shaheed Sthal / New Bus Adda)**

If you need to reach central Ghaziabad, Mohan Nagar, Arthala, or the Hindon River region, you will need to take an interchange route to access DMRC's Red Line.

1. Board the **Pink Line** at Anand Vihar towards **Shiv Vihar**.
2. De-board at **Welcome Metro Station** and switch over to the **Red Line** heading towards **Shaheed Sthal (New Bus Adda)**.
3. This route brings you directly into the heart of Ghaziabad city, passing major intersections like Raj Bagh, Mohan Nagar, and Shyam Park.

- **Travel Time:** \~40 to 45 minutes
- **Fare:** ₹40 to ₹50

## **The Game Changer: Namo Bharat High-Speed RRTS**

For those looking to bypass standard city traffic and standard metro stops altogether, the [**Delhi-Ghaziabad-Meerut RRTS corrido**](https://metroguideindia.com/namo-bharat/)**r** has completely transformed the transit infrastructure between these two hubs.

The [**Anand Vihar Namo Bharat Station**](https://metroguideindia.com/namo-bharat/stations/anand-vihar.html) is seamlessly integrated underground with the Anand Vihar Indian Railway Terminal, the Delhi Metro station (Blue/Pink Lines), and both the Delhi and Kaushambi ISBTs.

| **Journey Attribute** | **Namo Bharat Transit Details** |
| **Exact Track Distance** | 10.7 Kilometres |
| **Total Travel Time** | **11 minutes and 20 seconds** |
| **Intermediate Stops** | Sahibabad RRTS |
| **Standard Ticket Fare** | ₹40 |
| **Premium Ticket Fare** | ₹50 |
| **First/Last Train** | 06:13 AM / 10:13 PM (Mon-Sat) |

Choosing the Namo Bharat train slashes your commute time to a fraction of road travel, completely eliminating the bottlenecks at the Ghazipur border and the Mohan Nagar trisection.

## **Choosing Your Mode: Commuter Strategy Table**

To help you decide the most efficient transit mechanism based on your budget and destination, look at this structured breakdown for planning your next trip from [**anand vihar to ghaziabad metro**](https://metroguideindia.com/routes/anand-vihar-to-ghaziabad.html):

| **Transit Mode** | **Best Suited For** | **Travel Time** | **Cost Effectiveness** |
| **Blue Line Metro** | Commuters heading directly to Vaishali / Indirapuram sectors. | 8 Mins | High (₹10 - ₹20) |
| **Namo Bharat (RRTS)** | Ultra-fast transit to Sahibabad Industrial Area or Meerut Trisection. | 11 Mins | Excellent (Fixed ₹40) |
| **Red Line Metro** | Commuters traveling deeper into Ghaziabad City (Mohan Nagar/New Bus Adda). | 45 Mins | Moderate (₹40 - ₹50) |
| **Road Auto/Taxi** | Direct, door-to-door transit with heavy personal luggage. | 20-35 Mins | Low (₹150 - ₹400) |

## **Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)**

### **1. Anand Vihar se Ghaziabad kitne kilometre hai?**

Agar aap road se ja rahe hain toh Anand Vihar se Ghaziabad central ki duri lagbhag 14 se 16 kilometre hai. Wahi agar aap Vaishali (jo ki Ghaziabad ka hissa hai) ja rahe hain, toh wo Anand Vihar se keval 3 kilometer ki duri par sthit hai.

### **2. What is the first and last metro train timing from Anand Vihar to Vaishali?**

The first Blue Line metro train towards Vaishali leaves Anand Vihar at **06:13 AM**, and the last scheduled train departs at **10:33 PM**.

### **3. Can I use my standard Delhi Metro Smart Card on the Namo Bharat RRTS train?**

Yes, integrated smart transit options and QR-based ticketing portals are operational across the networks, but fare structures remain separate based on the designated RRTS layout.

### **4. Which platform should I stand on at Anand Vihar for Ghaziabad?**

For the direct Blue Line route to Ghaziabad (Vaishali), go to **Platform 1** at the Anand Vihar Metro Station. For the Namo Bharat high-speed rail towards Ghaziabad/Meerut, head to **Platform 1** of the underground RRTS complex.
